input_fields.name: preselection_candidates
input_fields.description: Known overlapping candidates at one fixed cursor location.

input_fields.name: mouse_position
input_fields.description: Fixed viewport position where candidates overlap.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified Ctrl+wheel mapping or a visible candidate-cycle equivalent.

result_fields.name: preselection_state
result_fields.description: Candidate order/identity before and after one cycle, cursor position, and control path.

procedure: Place the cursor at mouse_position without moving it during the test.
Check modifier/wheel support; use one calibrated Ctrl+wheel cycle or one visible candidate-cycle equivalent.
Observe pre-highlight/status-bar identity and return preselection_state.
Do not click or commit a selection as part of this cycle operation.
rejection_rules: Reject fewer than two candidates, moved cursor, unsupported combination without equivalent, or unobservable pre-highlight.
Do not claim candidate cycling from a wheel event alone.
